def: to move together, i.e. (specially), to excite as a mass (to sedition)

occurrences.text: And they stirred up the people, and the elders, and the scribes, and came upon him, and caught him, and brought him to the council,

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
